text:
Zoe H.: Flagging a telemetry/UX gap during the v2 opt-in wave: some tenants see a small billing bump in the console preview but raw billing aggregates don't match. Suspect attribution split between route and post-enrichment model_variant.

Marco L.: Saw this too. Quick repro trace:
```
2025-06-02T14:20:01Z routing: chosen=compat route=v1 tenant=finwave trace=tr_2025_999
2025-06-02T14:20:01Z enrichment: model_select=model-v2-quant trace=tr_2025_999
```
So two different attribution fields.

Priya V.: UX risk: customers will see inconsistent numbers. Short-term mitigations: hide "estimated billing delta" for affected cohorts and add a banner: "Attribution check in progress" with a link to sample traces.

Marco L.: Engineering fix proposal (low friction):
- inject header `X-RW-Attribution` at routing decision (values: v1|v2|compat)
- prevent enrichment from overriding that header (enrichment can add model_variant but not change X-RW-Attribution)
- ETL precedence: X-RW-Attribution -> route_tag -> model_variant; default missing -> v1 for billing safety
Estimated: routing change ~3-5hrs, enrichment guard ~2hrs, ETL change + 1% validation backfill ~6hrs.

Zoe H.: +1 to conservative default billing to v1 while we validate. Priya, can you prepare copy for the console banner? Keep it short: "Attribution mismatch detected — preview may be inaccurate. Click to view traces."

Priya V.: Yep, will add a pill and sample trace links. Also propose a preview endpoint param `?billing=sandbox` to surface sample-only numbers that are not billed.

ops-bot: Incident filed INC-2025-411: attribution mismatch in v2 rollout. Scheduling 1% validation backfill window 03:00-03:30 UTC. Will page oncall if CPU > 70%.

Marco L.: Owners: Marco (routing PR + tests), Zoe (validation + reconciliation), Priya (console copy + preview API), ops-bot (backfill window). We'll gate broader rollouts until mismatch_rate < 0.5%. :thumbsup:
